input.title: Give the newsletter email input an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale:
The input #news-email has no accessible name. There is a visible <label>Email address</label> just before it, but the label doesn't wrap the input and has no for attribute, so the two aren't linked. I can only edit the input itself, so this patch sets aria-label="Email address". That matches the visible label text exactly, so screen reader and voice control users get the same name sighted users see.

A better fix in the source would be to add for="news-email" to the <label> on line 11, then drop the aria-label. That links the label properly and lets users click the label to focus the field. The reviewer may want to make that change instead. This patch fixes the missing name reported here, but it doesn't make the page fully compliant.
